Would any of these work in your local time? If not, tell me the hours you have free and I’ll adapt.

- Wed 9/9 11:45–12:05 PT
- Thu 9/10 18:00–18:20 PT

Also fine to give me a few times you prefer and I’ll send an invite. Phone or Zoom — whichever you prefer.
